title: Folder Sync configuration
description: Configuration for a folder treated as a sync source. The folder containing this file is the source root; each entry in `destinations` names a workspace folder to sync into.

destinations.description: One or more destinations to sync this folder into. Each name must match a workspace folder currently open in vscode.dev.

name.description: The name of a workspace folder open in vscode.dev. Unresolved names are skipped at sync time with a warning.

path.description: Optional subpath within the destination workspace folder. Sync writes into `<workspaceFolder>/<path>`. Leave empty to write at the destination root.

exclude.description: Glob patterns to exclude, in addition to the built-in ignore list (.git, .DS_Store, ~$*, .sync.jsonc, .foldersync-manifest.json).

items.description: Glob pattern. Supports *, ?, **, and trailing /** to match a directory and its contents.

include.description: Glob patterns to include. Omit (or leave empty) to include everything not excluded.
